description: Deep system optimization for workstations and power users. Extends Pro with additional services, Windows features, scheduled tasks, visual effects, and advanced registry targets. System Restore point created before execution.

entries.displayName: Intel Thread Director Heterogeneous Scheduling Calibration
entries.warning: Exposes and prioritizes performance-core scheduling bias for foreground processes on hybrid architecture processors.

entries.displayName: AMD 3D V-Cache / Dual-CCD Scheduling Alignment
entries.warning: Guides the Windows scheduler to bias gaming threads toward Cache-frequency CCDs on multi-CCD AMD processors.

entries.displayName: DXGI Modern Flip Model & VRR Upgrade
entries.warning: Upgrades legacy windowed DX9/DX11 presentation to modern hardware flip model, unlocking lower input latency and VRR.

entries.displayName: Disable Uncalibrated AutoHDR Presentation Tone Mapping
entries.warning: Prevents unwanted GPU frame tone mapping overhead on SDR displays during high-FPS gaming.

entries.displayName: Memory Compression Page Combining Overhead Suppression
entries.warning: Suppresses memory page combining background cycles on 16GB+ systems, eliminating memory compression micro-stutters during heavy loads.

entries.displayName: Processor CPU Sets Interrupt Isolation
entries.warning: Enables Windows kernel CPU Sets support for directing hardware interrupts away from gaming cores.

entries.displayName: Direct3D Max Prerendered Frame Latency (1 Frame)
entries.warning: Restricts flip queue prerender buffer to 1 frame for direct mouse-to-pixel responsiveness.

entries.displayName: AVX Workload Processor Boost Policy Calibration
entries.warning: Unlocks aggressive processor performance boost controls for multi-threaded Blender/AfterEffects workloads.

entries.displayName: Disable PCIe ASPM Link State Power Management on AC
entries.warning: Prevents PCI Express link state power transitions on AC to eliminate GPU and NVMe wake latency.

entries.displayName: Lock Windows Kernel Executive & Core Drivers in RAM
entries.warning: Forces operating system kernel and drivers to remain in fast physical memory without paging to disk.

entries.displayName: Hypervisor SLAT Virtualization NUMA Alignment
entries.warning: Aligns hardware-assisted virtualization pages with primary NUMA node for maximum emulator IPC.

entries.displayName: NVIDIA PowerMizer Prefer Maximum Performance
entries.warning: Forces NVIDIA GPU clock states to maintain maximum rated frequencies under desktop 3D load.

entries.displayName: Multi-Group Processor Thread Scheduling Balance
entries.warning: Balances thread allocation across multiple 64-logical-processor groups on high-core workstations.

entries.displayName: NUMA Node Proximity Memory Allocation
entries.warning: Allocates physical RAM strictly from the local NUMA node nearest to the executing core.

entries.displayName: Enforce DirectX 12 Hardware Accelerated GPU Scheduling
entries.warning: Offloads GPU context switching and memory management directly to dedicated GPU microcode.

entries.displayName: VRAM Overcommit Demote to High-Speed System RAM
entries.warning: Prevents catastrophic frame drops during video rendering when VRAM capacity is exceeded.

entries.displayName: Disable Dynamic Kernel Tick for Ultra-Low Jitter
entries.warning: Eliminates timer synchronization delays and timer sleep states on AC power.

entries.displayName: HAL Device Interrupt Affinity Balancing Away from Core 0
entries.warning: Distributes hardware DPC/ISR clock interrupts across all logical cores to prevent Core 0 bottlenecks.

entries.displayName: Align NTFS Sector Allocation with NVMe 4KB Physical Boundaries
entries.warning: Guarantees all file allocations align with SSD physical 4KB NAND flash block pages.

entries.displayName: Disable Real-Time File System Compression on High-Speed Volumes
entries.warning: Eliminates CPU decompression overhead across high-performance NVMe solid-state storage.

entries.displayName: Lock WASAPI Real-Time Buffer Against Underrun
entries.warning: Allows audio engine threads to execute across all performance cores to eliminate sound glitches.

entries.displayName: Bypass DWM Double-Buffering for Borderless Windowed Apps
entries.warning: Enables direct independent flip queue for borderless games and emulators.

entries.displayName: Disable PCIe Active State Power Management (ASPM) on AC
entries.warning: Maintains continuous full-speed PCIe Gen4/Gen5 bus links to graphics cards and NVMe drives on AC power.

entries.displayName: Enable Hardware Offload for Large TCP and UDP Checksums
entries.warning: Offloads packet checksum calculation entirely to the physical network controller ASIC.

entries.displayName: Enable Explicit Congestion Notification (ECN)
entries.warning: Signals packet congestion before router buffers drop packets, preventing game disconnects.

entries.displayName: Lock Intel Speed Shift & AMD CPPC Energy Preference to 0 (Performance)
entries.warning: Instructs autonomous CPU hardware frequency governor to ramp to max clock frequencies instantaneously.

entries.displayName: Pace Memory Manager Dirty Page Flushes to Prevent Frame Stutter
entries.warning: Flushes modified pages smoothly in small bursts, preventing sudden disk write spikes during games.

entries.displayName: Disable D3Cold Deep Power State for Active Controllers on AC
entries.warning: Prevents USB controllers and audio DACs from entering deep low-power sleep states on AC power.

entries.displayName: Lock Executive Scheduler Foreground Boost Quantum
entries.warning: Dedicates maximum continuous CPU timeslices to active foreground render pipelines.

entries.displayName: Disable StorPort Idle Low Power Transitions on Primary NVMe
entries.warning: Disables host-initiated power management on storage controller bus, eliminating wake-up latency.

entries.displayName: Select Compound TCP Congestion Control Algorithm
entries.warning: Optimizes TCP congestion window scaling over gigabit fiber internet links.

entries.displayName: Configure Autonomous Standby Cache Recovery Threshold
entries.warning: Informs Windows memory manager of exact L2/L3 CPU cache sizes for optimal page coloring.

entries.displayName: Configure Dedicated SSD Paging Path for Kernel Safety
entries.warning: Isolates crash telemetry from main operating pagefile for maximum data recovery resilience.

entries.displayName: Isolate Non-Critical System Daemons via Dynamic CPU Sets
entries.warning: Restricts background telemetry and indexer worker threads away from primary gaming execution cores.

entries.displayName: Disable USB 3.0 U1/U2 Link Power State Management on AC
entries.warning: Eliminates low-power link dropouts on USB 3.0 audio interfaces and gaming capture cards.

entries.displayName: Audit Kernel Retpoline & Speculative Execution Engine State
entries.warning: Enables Retpoline branch target mitigations for near-zero speculative execution CPU overhead.

entries.displayName: Windows DirectStorage BypassIO Storage Stack Optimization
entries.warning: Configures DirectStorage BypassIO storage stack pass-through, eliminating legacy filesystem filter driver latency.

entries.displayName: Set Processor Idle Demote Threshold to 100% on AC Power
entries.warning: Prevents the Windows kernel power scheduler from prematurely demoting active compute cores into low-power sleep states during load.

entries.displayName: PCIe Resizable BAR Bandwidth Allocation Optimization
entries.warning: Enables full 64-bit PCIe aperture mapping for modern DirectX 12 and Vulkan rendering workloads.

entries.displayName: Set Third Level Data Cache (L3) Detection to Hardware Auto-Query
entries.warning: Directs Windows kernel memory manager to use CPUID L3 cache sizing for large game heap allocations.

entries.displayName: Configure Processor Performance Time Check to 1 Millisecond
entries.warning: Minimizes clock frequency re-evaluation interval (1ms) for instantaneous frequency ramping upon gaming thread demand spikes.

entries.displayName: Lock GPU Driver Prerendered Frame Queue to 1 for Minimal Input Latency
entries.warning: Limits driver presentation buffer to 1 frame to reduce input lag in mouse and keyboard tracking.

entries.displayName: Enable Kernel DMA Remapping Protection Guard
entries.warning: Enables kernel direct memory access protection remapping for high-speed PCIe peripheral interfaces.

entries.displayName: Disable NTFS 8.3 Short Name Generation Across Volumes
entries.warning: Disables legacy MS-DOS 8.3 short filename generation, accelerating NTFS file creation on high-capacity SSDs.

entries.displayName: Enable DXGI Variable Refresh Rate Hardware Tearing
entries.warning: Enables true zero-latency VRR / G-Sync presentation path in DX12.

entries.displayName: Enable Multithreaded GPU Command Submission
entries.warning: Allows parallel command buffer dispatch to discrete GPU queues.

entries.displayName: Enforce Zero-Corruption NVMe Flush Protocol
entries.warning: Ensures storage flush commands remain intact for NVMe integrity.

entries.displayName: Reserve 64-Bit MMIO Aperture Space Above 4GB
entries.warning: Guarantees full VRAM addressing for Resizable BAR without MMIO clipping.

entries.displayName: Disable Memory Compression Overhead on High-RAM Workstations
entries.warning: Disables proactive background paging under abundant physical memory.

entries.displayName: Declare L2 Hardware Cache Baseline Descriptor
entries.warning: Provides Windows memory manager explicit L2 cache dimensioning.
entries.name: Executive Worker Thread Concurrency

entries.displayName: Enable Direct Cache Access (DCA) for Network Controller
entries.warning: Allows high-speed PCIe NICs to transfer incoming packets directly to CPU L3.

entries.displayName: Enable TCPA Hardware Acceleration for Multi-Gigabit NICs
entries.warning: Offloads TCP memory transfers to dedicated DMA hardware engines.

entries.displayName: Disable PCIe ASPM Link State Power Savings on AC
entries.warning: Prevents PCIe link state down-negotiation latency on AC power.

entries.displayName: Disable NVMe Link Power Management on AC
entries.warning: Keeps NVMe drives in high-speed D0 active state on AC power.

entries.displayName: Configure IP Helper Service to Demand Start
entries.warning: Reduces background memory overhead when legacy IPv6 6to4 tunnels are unused.

entries.displayName: Reduce SMB LanmanServer Idle Session Timeout
entries.warning: Reclaims unused network session memory handles after 15 minutes.

entries.displayName: Disable SQM PI Telemetry Aggregation Task
entries.warning: Disables background software quality metrics aggregation task.

entries.displayName: Disable File History Background Maintenance
entries.warning: Suppresses automatic File History background catalog scanning.
